sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Let's explore how to hide the messy details of your code while keeping it powerful and easy to use!

• What class abstraction and encapsulation really mean
• How to protect your data like a pro
• Why these concepts make your code cleaner and safer

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Imagine a coffee machine. You press a button and get coffee - you don't need to know how the beans are ground or how the water is heated. That's abstraction!

**Abstraction** hides complex details while showing only what's necessary.

• Think of a car's steering wheel - you don't need to know how the engine works to drive
• In code, abstraction means exposing simple methods while hiding complex logic

**Encapsulation** is like putting your data in a protective capsule.

• It bundles data and methods that work on that data
• It restricts direct access to some components (like private variables)
• It prevents accidental modification of important data

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: Class abstraction separates the class interface (what it does) from its implementation (how)
Users of a class interact through its public methods without knowing internal details
Encapsulation hides data fields and implementation methods behind a public API
A well-designed class can change its implementation without affecting code that uses it
Abstraction reduces complexity by letting each class focus on its own responsibility

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Abstraction = Hide complexity, show simplicity. Encapsulation = Protect your data like a fortress. Always use private fields with public methods.
